sources.title: agent-deck README.md
sources.locator: Installation; Quick Start; Features; Multi-Tool Support; Conductor; Remote Instances; Web Mode
sources.finding: Terminal command center for independent coding sessions, with CLI, web UI, conductor orchestration, Docker/worktrees, remote SSH decks, usage metrics and opt-in telemetry.

sources.title: agent-deck LICENSE
sources.finding: MIT license at pinned application revision.

sources.title: agent-deck docs/ROADMAP.md
sources.locator: Status lights; Health, metrics and performance; Security and signing
sources.finding: Unscheduled roadmap lists status detection gaps, remote notification follow-ups and signed/notarized macOS release work. These are not shipped claims.

sources.title: agent-deck README
sources.locator: Vendor terms and logins > Claude Code; Cost Tracking Dashboard
sources.finding: Agent Deck runs the unmodified agent CLIs with the user's own login or API key, so model usage is paid to the provider; the README describes a dashboard that tracks those provider costs but states no Agent Deck price.

sources.title: Agent Deck session tool mapping
sources.finding: Creating a session with the command aider resolves to the built-in Aider tool identity and runs the aider command in the session.

sources.title: Agent Deck built-in tool registry
sources.finding: Aider is a registered built-in tool name with its own icon and colour, but carries no detection patterns, so running aider sessions are not status-detected as Aider.

sources.title: Agent Deck website source
sources.locator: site/index.html lines 60-128 (JSON-LD offer and FAQ), tag v1.16.38, commit 6c48533; canonical page asheshgoplani.github.io/agent-deck returned 404 and agent-deck.com did not resolve on 2026-11-10
sources.finding: The in-repo website source lists a 0 USD offer, says Agent Deck is completely free and open source under MIT, and says it supports Claude Code, Aider, Gemini CLI, Codex and any terminal program. The page metadata names an old version (0.15.0).

sources.finding: The latest release publishes free downloadable macOS and Linux binaries of the CLI/TUI on GitHub.

sources.title: Agent Deck README: Vendor terms and logins
sources.locator: README.md lines 878-889 (Vendor terms and logins), tag v1.16.38, commit 6c48533
sources.finding: Agent Deck runs the unmodified claude CLI with the user's own login, recommends an API key or Team/Enterprise plan for heavy unattended use, and supports passing a Claude setup-token via an env_file.
